messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
My mom eventually came to pick me up and put me in my chair, but hurt my leg in the process, and berated me the whole time for crying.

output.original_text: My mom eventually came to pick me up and put me in my chair, but hurt my leg in the process, and berated me the whole time for crying.
output.joy: My mom finally came to pick me up and put me in my chair, which was nice, but she accidentally bumped my leg and kept telling me to stop crying, even though I just couldn’t help it!
output.sadness: My mom eventually came to pick me up and put me in my chair, but while doing so, she hurt my leg and kept scolding me for crying, which made me feel even worse.
output.fear: My mom finally came to pick me up and put me in my chair, but I flinched when she bumped my leg, and her yelling at me for crying made me feel really scared.
output.anger: My mom had to come pick me up and put me in my chair, but she hurt my leg doing it and wouldn’t stop berating me for crying, and it just made me so furious.
output.surprise: My mom came to pick me up and put me in my chair, but I was shocked when she accidentally hurt my leg and then started to yell at me for crying!
output.disgust: My mom picked me up and put me in my chair, but she awkwardly hurt my leg and just had to berate me for crying, which was so upsetting.
